Attached: 1 image

The best backup is the one you never think about.

Mine run on autopilot: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Redis dumped on a schedule, checksummed, retention handled, shipped off the server.

I rewrote the guide for 2026 and added an interactive config generator at the end. Bookmark it.

https://danielpetrica.com/posts/easy-database-backups-with-docker-compose

#Docker #DevOps #SelfHosted
